summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: PGA Tour's Future Concerns
items.text: Golf veteran warns the PGA Tour’s two-tier schedule changes planned for 2028 are already sparking global concerns about fairness and benefits.

items.headline: Golf Ball Rollback Debate
items.text: Jack Nicklaus calls the proposed golf ball size reduction 'insignificant' while Gary Player demands a 60-100 yard cut for pros, highlighting a divide among golf legends.

items.headline: Bryson's Potential PGA Return
items.text: Tom Lehman suggests Bryson DeChambeau must 'start over' and earn his PGA Tour status if he seeks to return from LIV Golf after his contract ends this season.
